qs.q: A microbiology student is reviewing mechanisms of bacterial genetic exchange. During an experiment, naked DNA fragments released from lysed cells are taken up directly from the extracellular environment by competent recipient bacteria. What term best describes this specific horizontal gene transfer process?
o: Conjugative transfer through sex pilus bridges
qs.e: Transformation is the process by which bacteria take up naked, extracellular DNA fragments and incorporate them into their genomes.

qs.q: A researcher studying bacterial genetic variation observes the transfer of naked chromosomal DNA fragments from a lysed donor cell directly into a competent recipient cell. What specific mechanism of horizontal gene transfer is being demonstrated here?
o: Uptake of free extracellular DNA by a competent recipient cell
Movement of genes via plasmid-mediated mobilization pathways
Gene transfer by a temperate bacteriophage during infection
Transfer of DNA through a sex pilus during bacterial mating
Insertion of DNA segments using mobile genetic transposons
qs.e: Transformation involves the uptake and incorporation of naked extracellular DNA fragments by competent bacterial cells from their environment.
